name: Dynamic Finance Tracker Web App [ Mysql  PHP  HTML  CSS  JS ]
description: Finance Tracker is a lightweight yet powerful personal finance application that runs entirely in the browser. It is designed for students, working professionals, and anyone who wants a clear, simple, and reliable way to manage their personal finances without the complexity of traditional accounting software.The app combines a clean, modern user interface with practical financial tools — giving you a real-time view of your income, spending, savings goals, and loan EMIs. It's fast, private, and works beautifully on any device.

name: Dynamic Marge Mint - PDF Editor - [ Python  Html CSS JS ]
description: Seamlessly Convert & Merge — Powerful, responsive, and blazing-fast PDF utilities in your browser. Convert JPG, PNG, and WEBP images into professional PDFs with drag-and-drop ease. Features include multi-file upload, smart arrange, background fix, border, crop, watermark, quality control, visual filters, page settings, page numbers, one-click optimize, PDF preview, and PDF merging. Built with Python (Flask, Pillow, ReportLab, pypdf) on the backend and HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript on the frontend. Deployed live on Netlify and Render. Mobile-first responsive UI — tested on Galaxy S24 Ultra. Future scope: AI Image Analyzer, Resume Builder, and OCR Text Extractor.

name: API Based Equation-Graph Generator [ HTML CSS JS API ]
description: Interactive Graph Plotter is a web-based mathematical graph visualization tool developed using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and a Mathematics API to provide real-time visualization of mathematical equations and functions. The system allows users to enter equations such as sin(x), cos(x), tan(x), polynomial, exponential, logarithmic, and other mathematical functions and instantly generate their corresponding live graphs without refreshing the page. It supports 9 different graph formats, providing flexible ways to visualize and analyze mathematical expressions. The application also includes interactive graph controls, real-time equation processing, responsive design, and the ability to save generated graphs as PDF, making it a useful and user-friendly platform for learning, analyzing, and visualizing mathematical concepts.

name: Android e-learning application - ready4stud [ Kotlin ]
description: Ready4Study is an e-learning application designed to provide students with an easy, interactive, and accessible platform for digital learning. The application is developed using XML for the frontend, Java for the backend, and Firebase as the database for storing and managing application data. It can provide students with access to learning materials, courses, study resources, and other educational content through a user-friendly interface. The main objective of Ready4Study is to make online education more convenient, organized, and accessible while providing students with a reliable platform for improving their knowledge and academic skills.

name: PixelShrink - Web App [ Python Fast API  React JS ]
description: PixelShrink is a high-performance web-based image compression and optimization tool built using React for a fluid user interface and Python for robust backend processing. The platform allows users to upload single or multiple images, adjust compression quality metrics, and instantly shrink file sizes while preserving visual clarity. Featuring intelligent batch processing, real-time live previews, and drag-and-drop functionality, it provides an intuitive solution for web developers, photographers, and content creators looking to optimize media assets for faster web performance.

name: ChatApp — Real-Time Chat [ React JS · Python FastAPI · Socket.IO · Redis · MySQL ]
description: ChatApp is a full-stack, real-time messaging platform built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS on the frontend and Python FastAPI with Socket.IO, Redis, and MySQL on the backend. It delivers instant one-to-one and group messaging with live delivery, typing indicators, presence, and read receipts — powered by a Redis Pub/Sub adapter that keeps multiple Socket.IO servers in sync. Users can share images and files with inline previews, reply to specific messages with scroll-to-context highlighting, react with emojis that persist across sessions, and delete messages either for themselves or for everyone with proper soft-delete semantics. Group chats support creator/admin/member roles, per-member permissions (add, remove, send), custom avatars, descriptions, and full member CRUD. A dedicated poll system lets users create single or multiple-choice polls with optional anonymity, auto-close timers, live percentage results, voter insights, and creator-only controls. Security is handled with bcrypt password hashing, JWT authentication, membership checks on every socket event, rate limiting via Redis, and CORS restricted to trusted origins. The UI is fully mobile-responsive with a slide-in sidebar, glassmorphism surfaces, animated typing dots, image lightboxes, chat wallpapers with adjustable blur and darkness, and customizable accent colors — all persisted per user. A built-in notification system combines in-app toasts, unread badges, and browser push (VAPID) so users never miss a message. Ideal for teams, friend groups, study circles, and anyone who wants a fast, private, self-hostable alternative to mainstream messaging apps.
